qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for pipes to engine oil cooler?
What torque should be applied to pipes to oil filter head on the E36 M3?
What torque and screw type are specified for the holder for oil cooler pipes to alternator on the E36 M3?
Which oil cooler pipe components apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Pipes to engine oil cooler (1AZ) and holder on oil cooler pipes (3AZ)

qa_pairs.question: Which oil cooler pipe specifications are specific to the E36 M3?
qa_pairs.answer: Pipes to oil filter head (2AZ) and holder for oil cooler pipes to alternator (4AZ)

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between pipes to engine oil cooler and pipes to oil filter head?
Which oil cooler pipe component has the lowest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: Holder on oil cooler pipes at 6 Nm

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection does this oil cooler pipes specification belong to?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 17-4 Radiator, subsection 17 22 Oil Cooler Pipes
